title: My profile
text: Everything you’ve saved has its own page now: your school and grades, emails and texts, what you follow, your favorites and your plans. Sharing and signing out stay on your account page.

title: This week at your school
text: Each school’s page now shows the week ahead: days off and sign-ups. You can get it by email on Sunday mornings: keep your school in your profile and turn it on under Emails and texts.

title: Your own dates, and faster emails
text: Add picture day, pretzel day or a form that’s due to My kids’ calendar, for one child or everyone. And a sign-up date you follow is now emailed the morning after it’s posted, then the day before and that morning, each with a link to stop that one listing.

title: Follow and favorites
text: Follow a program, a camp or your school and its dates come by email. Save a listing as a favorite to find it again. Both are listed on this page.

title: One page for every planner
text: The week, the days off and the summer, side by side, with what each one does.

title: My kids’ calendar
text: Everything you’ve planned for the year in one private calendar, with a file for your phone.
